lines.text: A man sold a country that didn't exist.

parts.tts: A man sold a country that didn't exist.
parts.heard: A man sold a country that didn't exist.

lines.text: In 1822, Gregor MacGregor told London he ruled a land called Poyais.

parts.tts: In eighteen twenty-two, Gregor MacGregor told London he ruled a land called Poyais.
parts.heard: In 1822, Gregor MacGregor told London he ruled a land called Poyais.

lines.text: He printed a guidebook, its own money... and sold its government bonds.

parts.tts: He printed a guidebook, its own money...
parts.heard: He printed a guidebook, its own money.

lines.text: Investors bought about 200,000 pounds of them.

parts.tts: Investors bought about two hundred thousand pounds of them.
parts.heard: investors bought about 200,000 pounds of them.

parts.tts: Then about two hundred fifty settlers sailed there.

lines.text: They found... jungle. No towns. No capital. No country.

parts.tts: jungle. No towns. No capital. No country.
parts.heard: jungle, no towns, no capital, no country.

lines.text: MacGregor was later tried for fraud in France... and acquitted.
